description: Local government stance toward data centers and large loads for a Texas county or city, or for the county and city at an address or coordinate: a score built from official actions since September 2024 (Chapter 312 and 380/381 abatements, JETI, reinvestment zones, zoning and SUP votes, development and water agreements, EDC incentives, moratoria, restrictive ordinances, zoning denials) plus projects withdrawn after opposition, weighted by type, each project counted once per jurisdiction, decayed with a 12-month half-life to zero at 24 months. Community opposition and lawsuits are listed but not scored. Counties and cities are scored separately. Returns score, stance (favorable 3+, leaning favorable 0.5 to 3, mixed or neutral under 0.5 either way, leaning hostile, hostile -3 or less), counts of positive, negative and neutral actions, and the recent actions with date, body, vote, project, summary and source links. Use when someone asks whether a county or city is friendly to data centers, where abatements are being granted, where projects have been denied or fought, or what the local politics are around a site. Pro.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

limit.description: Recent actions to list per jurisdiction. Default 10, max 30.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.
